categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the passenger transportation business using express buses, providing safe and comfortable travel services. Additionally, it operates a rental business involving self-owned buildings and engages in online ticket sales through telecommunications sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes modern express buses equipped with advanced systems such as the E-Pass system for on-board ticketing and QR code-based boarding verification. It employs systematic crew training to enhance service quality and safety, and operates an integrated online reservation and ticketing platform accessible via internet and mobile apps.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are travelers using express bus services across South Korea. The company serves the domestic passenger transportation market, targeting individuals seeking intercity travel via designated express bus routes nationwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide in South Korea, with main offices and terminals located in major cities including Busan, Seoul, and Daegu. Its service network covers 135 designated express bus routes across the country.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates downstream in the transportation supply chain, directly providing passenger transport services to end consumers. It procures fuel and maintains its fleet but primarily focuses on service delivery rather than upstream manufacturing or logistics.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding online ticket sales through partnerships with travel platforms, enhancing customer convenience via digital ticketing systems like E-Pass, and improving service quality with premium buses and facility upgrades. The company focuses on innovation in customer experience rather than product R&D.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through passenger transportation fares from express bus services. Additional income comes from rental operations of owned properties and commissions from ticket sales via third-party platform partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with seven other express bus operators nationwide and faces competition from high-speed rail services such as KTX and SRT. It maintains a competitive position by focusing on service quality, route management, and digital sales channels.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenues of approximately 439.98 billion KRW in the latest fiscal year, showing a 16.6% increase from the previous year. Despite revenue growth driven by post-COVID passenger recovery, it recorded an operating loss of about 51.48 billion KRW and a net loss of 48.13 billion KRW, indicating ongoing profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes customer satisfaction and safety by deploying modern buses and systematic crew training. It differentiates itself through convenient digital ticketing solutions, including mobile reservations and on-board payment systems, and continuous facility improvements to enhance passenger comfort.
